# Dashboard Builder

Helps you build beautiful dashboards with CSS Grid.

## Usage

Ask me to build a dashboard and I'll help you.

## Patterns

1. Use CSS Grid for layout
2. Gold/amber accent colors instead of purple
3. CSS-only charts when possible
4. Responsive design with min-width breakpoints

## Setup

No installation needed. This is a documentation-only skill.
